overview: TechLearn Academy — a dark-themed tech education website with 10 expandable course categories, each showing sub-courses inline via accordion layout.
features: Accordion course catalog with 10 categories (Full Stack, AI/ML, Frontend, Backend, DevOps, etc.)
5-8 sub-courses per category with difficulty badges and duration
Homepage hero, stats bar, featured courses, learning path, and testimonials
Contact form with backend submission storage
Dark navy and electric blue design with full accessibility
